subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Reminiscence
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e.** "Remembrance".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reminiscence**: (संस्मरण) - The act or process of recalling past experiences or events.

 
 
• **Example**: His diary was full of poignant reminiscences of his childhood.
 
 
 
• **Remembrance**: (स्मरण) - The action of remembering something or someone.
 
 
• **Example**: They held a minute of silence in remembrance of those who had died.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Remembrance".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Harsh**: (कठोर) - Unpleasantly rough or jarring to the senses.

 
 
• **Example**: The soap had a harsh chemical smell.
 
 
 
• **Benevolence**: (दयालुता) - The quality of being well-meaning; kindness.
 
 
• **Example**: The benevolence of her act was appreciated by all.
 
 
 
• **Oblivion**: (विस्मृति) - The state of being unaware or unconscious of what is happening.
 
 
• **Example**: The medication plunged him into oblivion.
